resource.title: Cornell CS 2110: Object-Oriented Programming and Data Structures（公开课程网站，含 slides、代码与作业说明）
resource.covers: 课程前半段正是本节点内容：Lecture 1 structured programming、Lecture 2 Objects、Lecture 3 Abstraction & encapsulation、Lecture 4 Specifications & testing、Lecture 5 Interfaces & subtyping、Lecture 6 Inheritance, dynamic dispatch, equality，以及 Lecture 8 Bags, Generics、Lecture 10 Ordered collections，配套 Discussion 5 Java collections 与 Discussion 6 Iterators。slides 与 demo code 公开可下载，作业有公开说明。

courses.course: CS 2110 Object-Oriented Programming and Data Structures
courses.prereq_text: We assume that all students in the class have prior programming experience with a general-purpose procedural language (e.g. Python, Java, …). Suitable courses offered by Cornell include CS 1110 and CS 1112. ... Knowledge of Java is not a prerequisite, but we do assume that you will be able to adapt your knowledge of other languages to this setting quickly.

Prerequisites At least one of: Undergraduate Semester level CS 1301 Minimum Grade of C / Undergraduate Semester level CS 1315 Minimum Grade of C / Undergraduate Semester level CS 1321 Minimum Grade of C
The course is designed for students with some programming experience, but if you have none and are motivated you will do fine.

notes: 原图建议前置 P.1.1（程序设计基础）：Cornell CS 2110 官方先修段落明写需要「prior programming experience with a general-purpose procedural language」，并点名 CS 1110/CS 1112（两门都是入门程序设计课），因此 P.1.1 记 supported。同一段还写 'Knowledge of Java is not a prerequisite'，即本节点不要求先学 Java（与 P.2.1 无关）。CS 2110 后半段是数据结构内容，对 P.1.2 略有超出但 OOP 主线（objects/encapsulation/inheritance/interfaces/generics）完整；Lecture 列表取自同站 schedule.html（Fall 2023，逐条核对 Lecture 1–6 标题）。本批两门课都直接教 OOP：Cornell CS 2110 与 GT CS 1331（后者的 Learning Outcomes 逐项列出 encapsulation、inheritance、polymorphism、compile-time polymorphism (generics)，与节点简介逐项对得上）。NYU CSCI-UA 102 的 bulletin 页面已改版打不开，未取到原文，因此未列入。
